C0453.title: Ding'an Man Sentenced to Five Years for Cashing Out RMB 75,000 with Another Person's Credit Card
C0453.summary: In April 2018, a man surnamed Chen from Ding'an, Hainan, exploited his role delivering credit cards to impersonate a bank employee, tricked the cardholder into revealing a verification code, activated the card, and used a POS terminal to fraudulently cash out RMB 75,000 to repay his own loans. In September 2022, the Hainan Second Intermediate People's Court upheld the first-instance judgment, sentencing Chen to five years in prison and a RMB 50,000 fine for credit card fraud.
